name: Shifting Jerkin
body:
Source Armor Master's Handbook pg. 25
Aura faint illusion and transmutation CL 3rd
Slot armor; Price 5,965 gp; Weight 8 lbs.
Description
This +1 lamellar cuirassUE grants its wearer shapeshifting. On command, the wearer of a shifting jerkin can change her appearance at will as per disguise self. If the wearer has a talents class feature (investigator talents, ninja tricks, rogue talents, or slayer talents), once per day she can spend 1 hour to swap out one talent for another for which she qualifies. She can’t swap a talent that is a prerequisites for other talents or feats she has.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, disguise self, fox's cunning; Price 3,065 gp
